title: Structure-Activity Relationships of Ligand Binding to Oxysterol-Binding Protein (OSBP) and OSBP-Related Protein 4.
authors: Severance, Zachary C; Nunez, Juan I; Le-McClain, Anh T; Malinky, Cori A; Bensen, Ryan C; Fogle, Robert S; Manginelli, Gianni W; Sakers, Sophia H; Falcon, Emily C; Bui, Richard Hoang; Snead, Kevin J; Bourne, Christina R; Burgett, Anthony W G
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氧化固醇结合蛋白与配体的构效关系，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) and OSBP-related protein 4 (ORP4) have emerged as potentially druggable targets in antiviral and precision cancer drug development. Multiple structurally diverse small molecules function through targeting the OSBP/ORP family of proteins, including the antiviral steroidal compounds OSW-1 and T-00127-HEV2. Here, the structure-activity relationships of oxysterols and related compound binding to human OSBP and ORP4 are characterized. Oxysterols with hydroxylation at various side chain positions (i.e., C-20, C-24, C-25, and C-27) horizontal line but not C-22 horizontal line confer high affinity interactions with OSBP and ORP4. A library of 20(S)-hydroxycholesterol analogues with varying sterol side chains reveal that side chain length modifications are not well tolerated for OSBP and ORP4 interactions. This side chain requirement is contradicted by the high affinity binding of T-00127-HEV2, a steroidal compound lacking the side chain. The binding results, in combination with docking studies using homology models of OSBP and ORP4, suggest multiple modes of steroidal ligand binding to OSBP and ORP4.
abstract_zh: 氧化固醇结合蛋白（OSBP）及其相关蛋白4（ORP4）已成为抗病毒和精准癌症药物开发中潜在的可成药靶点。多种结构多样的小分子通过靶向OSBP/ORP蛋白家族发挥作用，包括抗病毒甾体化合物OSW-1和T-00127-HEV2。本文表征了氧化固醇及相关化合物与人OSBP和ORP4结合的结构-活性关系。在侧链不同位置（即C-20、C-24、C-25和C-27）发生羟基化的氧化固醇——但C-22除外——赋予与OSBP和ORP4的高亲和力相互作用。一个包含不同甾体侧链的20(S)-羟基胆固醇类似物库表明，侧链长度的修饰对OSBP和ORP4的相互作用耐受性不佳。这一侧链要求与T-00127-HEV2（一种缺乏侧链的甾体化合物）的高亲和力结合相矛盾。结合结果，连同使用OSBP和ORP4同源模型的对接研究，提示甾体配体与OSBP和ORP4存在多种结合模式。
